# UserScope

> Real-time open-source intelligence (OSINT) reconnaissance tool searching public usernames, accounts, and digital footprints across 700+ platforms.

UserScope allows security researchers, developers, and OSINT investigators to discover public account footprints across more than 700 online platforms simultaneously with zero paywalls.

## Capabilities

- [Reconnaissance Engine](https://userscope.app): Probes public APIs and profile endpoints directly with live SSE streaming telemetry.
- [Identity Synthesis](https://userscope.app): Aggregates profile photos, banners, discovered emails, locations, and aliases.
- [Multimodal Visualizations](https://userscope.app): Explore results through interactive relationship graphs, presence timelines, or responsive card layouts.
- [Structured Data Export](https://userscope.app): Download verified findings anytime in JSON or CSV formats.
